notes.title: Full Controller Support + Dev Console
notes.content:
This build doesn't contain much in the way of bug fixes or adjustments for the base game.  However, you can now use a gamepad to navigate the game from start to finish, including the options menu.

We've also added a dev console! Access this in game with the backquote (`) key.  The dev console allows you to:

[list]
[*] Load any checkpoint in the game
[*] Adjust difficulty on the fly
[*] Toggle cheats like godmode or x10 damage
[*] Quickly reset to the beginning of a level
[/list]

As development continues, most of these features will likely be added to the game's regular menus, but we've allowed players to access them now in order to smooth over their experience until that happens.

notes.title: New Patch + Mac Build Support
notes.content:
Hey! New patch for the pilot. Probably got one big one left before we get back to work on the full game.

Obviously the big news here is the new platform (yay) but for all you Windows players we do have some items worth considering:

[list]
[*] Scoring is fixed! Scores are now much more predictable and reflective of your performance in a level.
[*] Increased the number of bullets in a clip from 12 to 16.
[*] A successful parry restores 8 bullets to your clip (was 4 previously)
[*] Boosting now immediately restores 8 bullets to your clip (was 4 previously). Also increased the rate of additional bullets gained while holding boost.
[*] Successful parries now reduce your boost gauge.
[*] Boost initial cost reduced by 40%.  Boost ongoing cost reduced by 20%.
[*] Increased the health pools of some tankier enemies (as you're gonna be putting more bullets downrange now).
[*] Reduced the delay between missile lockons when holding the crosshair over a single lockon point.
[*] Fixed a bug where certain projectile sequences were not parriable under certain circumstances.
[/list]
